records.name: Buu Buu Ball
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Stamina Strike Evasive from PQ88 and restricted to Majin CaCs. The user curls into a ball and bounces three times; the bounce path can be freely controlled with directional input. Current skill-specific evidence reports about 2% damage on contact. Exact invulnerability frames remain unresolved.

records.name: Dodoria Headbutt
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super learned from Dodoria's Lesson 2. The user charges forward head-first; a successful hit breaks the opponent's guard and deals about 20% source-reported damage. On a miss, the user remains exposed while rubbing their head for about 4 seconds. A successful hit can immediately transition into an Ultimate. Exact frame data and universal damage values remain unresolved.

records.name: Dodoria Launcher
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate learned from Dodoria's Lesson 3. The attack begins with a two-handed energy beam reported at 16 hits and about 10% source-reported damage, followed by a Ki-blast barrage reported at up to 33 hits and about 25% additional damage. Directional input can spread the follow-up blasts instead of keeping them focused on the target. Exact timing, tracking, and universal damage values remain unresolved.

records.name: Elite Shooting
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super learned from Jaco's Lesson 2. The user fires repeated energy beams in a ray-gun-style pattern; current technique documentation describes either five-direction firing or rapid repeated shots along the same direction. Xenoverse 2's Future Warrior version reproduces the technique without the physical ray gun. Exact shot count in each in-game branch, tracking, timing, and damage remain unresolved.
